key_insight: The study introduces a practical rubric for scoring ethical issues in clinical AI tools across five key areas before and after deployment.
clinical_relevance: Healthcare teams can use this framework to compare AI tools, identify ethical risks, and support safer, more transparent adoption in clinical settings.
method: Multidisciplinary team developed a replicable scoring rubric
Five content areas: evaluation population, accessibility, clinical bias, user control, monitoring and updates
Applied the rubric to three clinical AI tools using publicly available information
evidence_signal: The rubric was tested on three AI tools spanning decision support, documentation, and image analysis, with evaluation based only on publicly available information.
watch_item: Because the assessment relies on public information, it may miss important real-world performance and workflow issues after deployment.
paper_title: Scoring Rubric to Assess Ethical Issues in Clinical Artificial Intelligence Tools
